limitations: Observer v4 exports spawn/agent IDs but no runtime GUID or life incarnation; continuity applies only to observed snapshots.
No player count, kill credit or teleport/test-hook audit in v4: this cannot alone prove playerless operation or the killer.
home is the stored agent home; home_distance uses the runtime creature home. Exact runtime home equality needs a separate diagnostic.

Physical arrival means sampled XY displacement >1 yard after an observed FEEDING/FED hunger drop, from >14 to <=14 yards before the next hunt/meal. Absence of external teleport is not provable from these fields.
Duplicate captures are ignored; stale/missing/non-v4 frames, changed homes, invalid predator or a >10-second capture gap interrupts pending cycle evidence.
Dead/respawning prey may have living_role:null; their authoritative PREY identity remains checked. A live prey initialization gap is reported separately.
An unfinished final gzip member may be read only with --allow-open-last; its missing footer cannot provide final CRC completeness.
Metadata SHA256 and before/after recording fingerprints bind stable files; changed/open recording files remain preliminary evidence.
